title: Independent zero-network audit of GMGN CLI proxy transport root-cause repair
objective: Independently audit GMGN-CLI-PROXY-TRANSPORT-ROOT-CAUSE-REPAIR-001 with a distinct HARNESS_AGENT_ID and zero network/provider requests. Verify allowlisted proxy forwarding, no ALL_PROXY, scheme fail-closed, fixed NODE_OPTIONS without parent inheritance, stats private-key exclusion, signed preflight, timeout kill once, expanded safe error codes without raw stderr leakage, and that no live recovery claim is made.
forbidden_actions: Do not invoke GMGN, Helius, Chain.fm, Dune, Dexscreener, Birdeye, RPC, browser, web scraping, or any network provider.
Do not inspect, display, retain, or test against credential values, proxy URL values, plaintext addresses, labels, raw payloads, raw stdout/stderr, or complete exceptions.
Do not modify application code, tests, package manifests, or implementer evidence.
